siop_planned.comment: Optional fallback source of Planned Start for spools not found in the Weekly Production Planning workbook - see merge.py -> apply_siop_fallback(). Filename is inconsistent; this pattern just requires SIOP, then Planned, then Spools to appear in that order.

rework.comment: QA/QC's Production Rework Data workbook - lives in paths.quality_upload_folder (data/upload/quality/), NOT paths.upload_folder, since it's synced separately from the DPR/Weekly/Line History/SIOP files. Optional PDQC override source - see reader.py -> read_rework() and merge.py -> apply_rework_pdqc_override(). Also the source for the Quality Assurance/Control dashboard - see src/quality/ and config/quality_settings.json.

material_handover.comment: Material Handover tracking workbook (one row per spool) - lives in paths.production_upload_folder (data/upload/production/), the folder previously reserved for future Production-only charts (see that folder's README.txt and src/departments.py). Optional, best-effort source for the Material Handover section of the Production dashboard - see reader.py -> read_material_handover() and src/production/material_handover.py. A missing file only skips that section; it never blocks the rest of the Production dashboard.

publishing.comment: When true, every pipeline run also copies the dashboard bundle (see output_files.dashboard_bundle above) into paths.website_data_folder (website/data/ by default) - that's the file the hosted website auto-loads for every viewer. Set to false if you only want the local upload-a-file workflow and don't want the published copy touched.
